newsitem.title: USA: Pease Oil sets drilling participation.
newsitem.headline: Pease Oil sets drilling participation.

text.p: Pease Oil and Gas Co said Wednesday it has committed to participate in a natural gas prospect in Jefferson Davis Parish, La., with National Energy Group Inc that is scheduled to start drilling next month.

In addition, Pease said, it has reached an informal agreement with National Energy Group to participate in an additional eight to 10 projects over the next 12 to 18 months with working interests ranging from 6.25 to 25 percent.
This informal agreement for the additional projects is subject to several contingencies including successfully negotiating and executing formal agreements to participate.
